title: smime-tree: malformed bag cert silently skipped, can bypass cycle detection
description: cert.rs:140-141 builds bag_by_subject with filter_map(...ok()...) — a cert whose subject DER encoding fails is silently dropped. The cycle-detection visited set is built only from certs that make it into the map. A malformed cert with a duplicate parseable subject could bypass cycle detection. Correct behavior: treat a DER-malformed cert as unusable-but-present (return an error or include a poison entry in the map), not silently absent.
